name: Aluminum
notes: Light structural base metal; high corrosion resistance and thermal conductivity.

name: Titanium
notes: Hexagonal close-packed alpha phase at RT; high strength-to-weight ratio.

name: Vanadium
notes: Body-centered cubic; acts as beta-stabilizer in titanium alloys.

name: Chromium
notes: Essential for passivation layer in stainless steels and oxidation resistance in superalloys.

name: Manganese
notes: Solid-solution strengthener and deoxidizer in steels and aluminum alloys.

name: Iron
notes: Alpha-ferrite at RT; foundational base metal for steels and maraging alloys.

name: Cobalt
notes: Epsilon-HCP at RT; matrix element for wear-resistant and medical implant alloys.

name: Nickel
notes: Face-centered cubic; matrix element for high-temperature aerospace superalloys.

name: Copper
notes: High electrical and thermal conductivity; ductile FCC matrix.

name: Zinc
notes: Major precipitation alloying element in 7xxx aerospace aluminum.

name: Scandium
notes: Extremely potent grain refiner forming coherent Al3Sc precipitates in Scalmalloy.

name: Zirconium
notes: Grain boundary strengthener and thermal stabilizer in advanced aluminum and refractory alloys.

name: Niobium
notes: Key precipitation former (gamma-double-prime Ni3Nb) in Inconel 718 superalloy.

name: Molybdenum
notes: Enhances resistance to pitting corrosion in 316L and solid-solution strength in Ni superalloys.

name: Tantalum
notes: Refractory metal with extreme corrosion resistance and bio-compatibility.

name: Tungsten
notes: Highest melting point of all metals; ultra-dense refractory metal.

name: Magnesium
notes: Lightest structural metal; alloying element in Scalmalloy and 5xxx/6xxx/7xxx Al.

name: Silicon
notes: Essential for fluidity and eutectic castability in additive AlSi10Mg powder.

name: Tin
notes: Solid-solution alpha stabilizer in near-alpha and alpha+beta titanium alloys.

name: Carbon
notes: Primary interstitial hardening element in steels; strictly controlled in 316L (<=0.03 wt%).

name: Nitrogen
notes: Potent interstitial strengthener and austenite stabilizer in stainless steels.

name: Oxygen
notes: Controlled interstitial element in titanium; strictly limited in Ti-6Al-4V ELI (<=0.13 wt%).
